question: According to Figure 4D-2, what are the general minimum and maximum longitudinal distances from the stop line for the primary signal faces, absent the near-side supplemental-face exception?
model_answer: Direct Answer: Figure 4D-2 shows a general minimum longitudinal distance of 40 feet from the stop line for primary signal faces, and a general maximum of 180 feet beyond the stop line (for 12-inch signal indications) unless a near-side supplemental signal face is provided. The figure also depicts a 120-foot maximum from the stop line for 8-inch signal faces. Standards (mandatory): - Primary signal faces "shall be located: 1. No less than 40 feet beyond the stop line, and 2. No more than 180 feet beyond the stop line unless a supplemental near-side signal face is provided." - "The primary signal faces that are used to satisfy the requirements of Item A shall simultaneously satisfy the lateral placement requirement described in Section 4D.07 (see Figure 4D-2)." - The lateral requirement referenced by the figure: the primary signal faces "shall be located between two lines intersecting with the center of the approach at a point 10 feet behind the stop line, one making an angle of approximately 20 degrees to the right of the center of the approach extended, and the other making an angle of approximately 20 degrees to the left of the center of the approach extended." Visual evidence: - [Image 1] Figure 4D-2 shows the dimensioned placement area with "40 ft*" (minimum distance of signal faces from stop line), "120 ft**" (maximum distance for 8-inch signal faces), and "180 ft***" (maximum distance for 12-inch signal faces, unless a near-side supplemental signal face is used), bounded laterally by two 20-degree lines from a point 10 feet behind the stop line. - [Image 2] Page 713 reproduces Figure 4D-2 with the same 40 ft minimum, 120 ft (8-inch) and 180 ft (12-inch) maximum dimensions and footnotes. - [Image 3] Page 714 contains Section 4D.08, stating the 40-foot minimum and 180-foot maximum (unless a supplemental near-side signal face is provided) longitudinal placement requirements. - [Image 4] Page 712 contains Section 4D.07, including the figure footnotes defining the 40 ft minimum, 120 ft (8-inch) maximum, and 180 ft (12-inch) maximum distances from the stop line. - [Image 5] Page 709 provides Section 4D.05 context on the number and location of signal faces referenced in Note 1 of Figure 4D-2. Citations: - Section 4D.08 Standard §1 (p.673) - Section 4D.07 Standard §1 (p.671) - Section 4D.07 Option §7 (p.672) - Figure 4D-2 (p.672) - Page 713 - Page 714 - Page 712 - Page 709
gold_answer: At least 40 feet and no more than 180 feet beyond the stop line.
